title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics across Python/TS/Go + parity fixes + v1.161.0
author: Sofia Patel
description: Motivation: SDK consumers need a consistent, ergonomic interface for auth + retries and streaming across Python, TypeScript, and Go. This PR unifies authentication initialization patterns, standardizes retry/backoff semantics, aligns streaming APIs (sync/async ergonomics), fixes parity gaps between SDKs, and bumps all SDK packages to v1.161.0. Changes include: - unified Auth config object (ApiKey/Token/KMS-backed) with consistent env var fallback and clearer error messages - standardized retry policy: idempotency-aware defaults, exponential backoff with jitter, circuit-breaker hooks for long-running streams - streaming parity: Python adds async iterator + sync generator, TS updates stream client to return AsyncIterable and readable stream wrapper, Go exposes StreamReader and simplified callback variant - ergonomics: context manager support in Python for auto-close, top-level async helpers in TS, simplified client.NewClient options in Go - parity fixes: method name alignment (embedding vs embeddings), options normalization (timeout vs deadline), and docs examples consolidated - release: version bump to v1.161.0 for python/ts/go and CHANGELOG entries for each SDK Checklist: - [x] design and API doc reviewed - [x] unit tests for retry and auth logic added - [x] integration tests for streaming added and flakiness addressed - [x] bump package versions and changelogs - [x] update samples and migration guide Links: design doc https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-1423/sdk-unify-auth-retries, migration notes in docs/sdks/migration-v1.161.0.md
